delete_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete
config_corrupt_quarantined: Could not read {file}. The file was kept at {path} and nothing was overwritten.
config_corrupt_not_quarantined: Could not read {file}, and it could not be moved aside either ({detail}). The file was left untouched.
config_unreadable_left_alone: Could not read {file} ({detail}). It was left exactly as it is, and nothing will be written to it this session. Close whatever is using it and start again.
config_write_blocked: Did not save {file}: it still holds a configuration that could not be read, and writing over it would destroy that.
firmware_missing: No UEFI firmware found next to QEMU. This VM cannot start until it is available.
firmware_uefi_hint: Required by Windows 11. Each VM keeps its own variable store so its boot entries survive.
option_substituted: not available — another accelerator is used at start
forwards_backend_only: Port forwarding works with user-mode networking only. These rules are kept but not applied.
template_notice_windows: Windows 11 refuses to install without TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, and neither is available here: a virtual TPM needs Unix sockets, which QEMU cannot offer on Windows. When Setup says this PC cannot run Windows 11, press Shift+F10, run regedit, and under HKLM\SYSTEM\Setup\LabConfig create the DWORD values BypassTPMCheck and BypassSecureBootCheck, both set to 1. Then go back and continue.
wizard_needs_template: Pick a template first, or the empty tile
pf_memory_over_host: {vm} MB is more than this host has ({host} MB)
pf_cores_over_host: {vm} cores are more than this host has ({host})
pf_accel_substituted: {stored} is not available here; {replacement} would be used instead. Choose one on purpose.
pf_backend_unavailable: This QEMU has no network backend {backend}
pf_machine_unknown: This QEMU does not know the machine type {machine}
pf_too_many_sata: {count} SATA disks, but the AHCI controller has {ports} ports
delete_removes_config: This removes the machine from the list.
delete_take_folder: Also take the folder and its files: {path}
delete_folder_failed: The folder {path} could not be removed: {error}
duplicate_image_shared: The image {path} lies outside the VM directory and was not copied. Both machines now use it, and running both at once destroys it.
duplicate_image_copy_failed: The image could not be copied to {path}: {error}. Both machines now use the original, and running both at once destroys it.
hint_net_user: (SLIRP NAT user-mode network with Internet access)
forwards_empty_hint: No port forwarding rules. A rule forwards a host port to a service in the guest, for example 2222 to 22 for SSH or 8080 to 80 for HTTP.
extra_args_hint: Additional command-line flags passed straight to QEMU, for example -usb -device usb-tablet -audiodev dsound,id=snd0
disks_empty_hint: No virtual hard disk attached. Use 'Add Disk' or 'Create Disk' to attach storage.
cdroms_empty_hint: No CD/DVD image attached. Use 'Add CD/DVD ISO' to mount install media.
console_title: QEMU live monitor and console output
console_running_hint: The machine is running. Its stdout and stderr are being captured.
console_stopped_hint: The machine is stopped. Launch it to see QEMU's output.
empty_state_hint: Select a virtual machine from the list, or create a new one.
console_copy_tip: Copy the whole console to the clipboard
console_awaiting: The machine is running. Waiting for output.
qemu_dir_auto: Found automatically (PATH and the usual places)
qemu_not_found: No QEMU in the chosen directory, and none on PATH
fullscreen_hint: Open the machine's window in fullscreen
qemu_img_missing: qemu-img was not found. Set the QEMU directory in the settings.
console_placeholder_running: {name} is running. Output is being streamed in the background.
console_placeholder_stopped: {name} is stopped. Launch it to start the emulation.
